status: accepted for candidate comparison per owner-directed closure of issue #134

pairing.pairing_unit: One independent fresh clone/database per binary in each pair, from identical pinned history and configuration; publish every raw measurement.
pairing.cache_policy: Warm-cache only. Before each runner invocation, warm the same real embedder with two fixed strings; do not reset filesystem/model caches between paired commands.
pairing.ratio: candidate elapsed seconds / v0.3.1 elapsed seconds
pairing.baseline_binary: Use the subsequently rebuilt, verified v0.3.1 binary at source commit f0a6b5d13ef3f8c5a4196aa655255a8f4f5d934d (SHA-256 a7fa5ee72e5ff83419918275c8eb813891a5e942997133ad99bcb2bffb395f9a) for all paired observations, and record its hash with every raw pair. The unpaired historical timings used an earlier binary hash recorded separately in environment.json.

primary_performance_gate.workload: Fresh full init of the 231-commit RepoDB history rooted at v0.3.0 commit f7cc6bc5451204c5696f1bbef7e5575772820f47.

uncertainty_rule.method: 100000 paired bootstrap resamples of the five pair ratios with replacement; Python random.Random seed 134032; nearest-rank one-sided 95th-percentile upper bound.
uncertainty_rule.failed_or_timed_out_measurement: comparison is inconclusive/fails; do not drop or replace an unfavorable pair

workloads: Fresh full refresh of the combined 26-language, two-commit corpus.
Full unchanged refresh command `refresh` on the RepoDB and combined-26 corpora.
Changed/no-op refresh command `refresh --changed` on the RepoDB and combined-26 corpora.
secondary_nonregression_gates.outlier_policy: Publish all pairs. Any individual ratio above 1.15 triggers an investigation and prevents a pass until explained; do not trim it. A documented external interruption may justify a complete, separately reported five-pair rerun, not a selective retry.

quality_and_reference_floors.exact_positive: 52/52 V1/V2 language-marker queries must retrieve the expected exact content and correct commit/path/line; every returned reference must resolve to matching source text.
quality_and_reference_floors.exact_negative: 26/26 generated absent-marker controls must return zero results.
quality_and_reference_floors.duplicate_explore: Enumerate all 30 results over pagination, with stable snapshot identity and unique reference IDs; include all 10 expected JavaScript paths and verify every reference against its referenced source lines.
quality_and_reference_floors.semantic_26: At least 11/26 language targets at top-5, and preserve target retrieval for every language that passes at baseline. Baseline 33/78 repeats is reported as 11/26 language probes passing on all three repeats, not 78 independent trials. This is a narrow marker-based regression check, not a general semantic-quality claim.
quality_and_reference_floors.issue_83_source_tasks: For each of the 14 frozen tasks, do not reduce the per-task median source-recall, source-reference-correctness, or answer-correctness scores in semantic or combined mode. Also do not reduce the baseline aggregate 3/42 source-reference-correct and 9/42 answer-correct outcomes per mode. The suite is sparse and not representative; these are regression floors only, not a general relevance claim.
quality_and_reference_floors.references: Every returned reference in all quality tasks must resolve to the pinned Git source and its claimed line range; where result text is present, it must match the source excerpt (content) or occur in the referenced diff-side excerpt. Text omitted by the CLI byte budget is checked by source path/range only.

resource_reporting: Report the sampled whole-refresh process-tree peak RSS (including the persistent embedder daemon) and database bytes for every pair. There is no numeric memory pass/fail ceiling; investigate unexpected increases. Persisted vector-row counts are reported, but embedder calls/batches and GPU telemetry are unavailable.
interpretation: Observed baseline timings and rankings are measurements, not acceptance thresholds. No candidate result or improvement claim exists yet.
